nodes.name: Every 30 Minutes
nodes.notes: Starts a poll every 30 minutes (production runs only - publish the workflow).

nodes.name: Build Sync Window
nodes.notes: Config + time window: last saved window end minus 2 min overlap (or last 35 min on the first run). Edit company IDs here.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Customers
nodes.notes: Simpro company customers modified since the window start (If-Modified-Since). IDs only, paginated 100/page.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Sites
nodes.notes: Simpro sites modified since the window start. Runs once; chained so each list is fetched exactly once.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Contacts
nodes.notes: Simpro contacts modified since the window start.

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Quotes
nodes.notes: Simpro quotes modified since the window start (company-scoped).

nodes.name: Fetch Changed Jobs
nodes.notes: Simpro jobs modified since the window start (company-scoped).

nodes.name: Build Record List
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: one item per changed record, shaped like the old webhook payload. Fails loudly on a non-200, a bad shape or a truncated page cap.

nodes.name: Has Records
nodes.notes: True: at least one changed record - loop. False: empty window - go straight to Finish Run so the window still advances.

nodes.name: Loop Over Records
nodes.notes: One record at a time (batch 1). Output 0 = done, output 1 = next record.

nodes.name: Sync Record
nodes.notes: Runs the Record Sync workflow for this one record and waits. A failure is captured (not thrown) so the rest of the batch still runs; Finish Run raises it at the end.

nodes.name: Note Result
nodes.notes: Collapses the sub-workflow output to ONE ok/failed item per record and feeds it back into the loop.

nodes.name: Finish Run
nodes.notes: Once per poll: throws if any record failed (window not advanced, next run retries it); otherwise saves the new window end.
